Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, as an RFC 3339 string with a zero offset.
Timestamp.title: Timestamp

description:
Obico reported a print failure.

The two instants are optional because Obico's own field for each is a Unix
timestamp number, an empty string, or absent, and the last two both mean the
producer reported no instant. An absent field here is that, never an epoch
date standing in for it.

ended_at.description: When the print ended, when Obico reported an instant for it.

file_name.description: The file being printed, when Obico named one.

is_warning.description: Whether Obico called it a warning rather than a failure.

obico_print_id.description: Obico's own identifier for the print, when it named one.

print_paused.description: Whether Obico paused the print itself.

started_at.description: When the print started, when Obico reported an instant for it.
